base.name: Base breakout on high volume
base.short: Closes above the highest close of the last 40 sessions out of a tight base, on heavy volume, in an uptrend
conditions: Close above the highest close of the previous 40 sessions
Those 40 sessions stayed within a 20% range (highest close to lowest close)
Volume at least 1.5 times its 50-day average
Close above the 200-day average
50-day average above the 200-day average
Average daily range (14 days) at least 2% of the price

pull.name: Pullback to a rising 50-day average
pull.short: A stock in an uptrend that has dipped back to its rising 50-day average with a cooled-off RSI
conditions: 50-day average up more than 2% over the last 10 sessions
Close above the 200-day average
Close between 5% below and 1% above the 50-day average
RSI (14) between 35 and 55
Close no more than 25% below the 52-week high
Average daily range (14 days) at least 2% of the price

squeeze.name: Squeeze breakout
squeeze.short: Bollinger Bands pinched to one of their narrowest readings in half a year, then a close above the 20-day high
conditions: Bollinger Band width (20 days, 2 standard deviations) in the narrowest 10% of the last 120 sessions
Close above the highest close of the previous 20 sessions
Volume at least equal to its 50-day average
Close above the 50-day average
Average daily range (14 days) at least 1.5% of the price

oversold.name: Oversold reversal
oversold.short: A stock 40% or more below its 52-week high that turns up: momentum improving and a close above the previous day's high
conditions: Close at least 40% below the 52-week high
RSI (14) between 30 and 50
MACD histogram higher than the day before
Close above the previous day's high
Volume at least equal to its 50-day average

high52.name: 52-week-high breakout
high52.short: Closes above the highest close of the last 252 sessions on heavy volume, with the 50-day above the 200-day
conditions: Close above the highest close of the previous 252 sessions
Volume at least 1.5 times its 50-day average
50-day average above the 200-day average

wash_turn.name: Washout: deep fall turning up
wash_turn.short: Market washout, a stock 60% or more below its 52-week high, and its MACD histogram rising
conditions: Market washout: fewer than 20% of this market's stocks close above their own 50-day average (needs 10 or more stocks with data that day)
Close at least 60% below the 52-week high
MACD histogram higher than the day before

deep_dry.name: Deep fall, volume dried up
deep_dry.short: A stock 60% or more below its 52-week high whose volume has dried up
conditions: Close at least 60% below the 52-week high
Quiet volume: average volume of the previous 10 sessions below 0.8 times the 50-day average volume

deep_vol.name: Deep fall, heavy volume
deep_vol.short: A stock 60% or more below its 52-week high on heavy volume
conditions: Close at least 60% below the 52-week high
Volume at least 1.5 times its 50-day average

wash_bounce.name: Washout bounce
wash_bounce.short: Market washout, a stock 40% or more below its 52-week high closing above the previous day's high
conditions: Market washout: fewer than 20% of this market's stocks close above their own 50-day average (needs 10 or more stocks with data that day)
Close at least 40% below the 52-week high
Close above the previous day's high

os60.name: Oversold reversal, 60%+ off the high
os60.short: The oversold reversal with a deeper fall: 60% or more below the 52-week high
conditions: Close at least 60% below the 52-week high
RSI (14) between 30 and 50
MACD histogram higher than the day before
Close above the previous day's high

os_hv.name: Oversold reversal, volatile stock
os_hv.short: The oversold reversal (40% off the high) in a stock whose daily range is 5% or more of its price
conditions: Close at least 40% below the 52-week high
RSI (14) between 30 and 50
MACD histogram higher than the day before
Close above the previous day's high
Daily range (14-day average true range) at least 5% of the price

hv_brk.name: High-volatility breakout
hv_brk.short: A stock with a daily range of 5% or more closing above its 40-session high on heavy volume
conditions: Daily range (14-day average true range) at least 5% of the price
Close above the highest close of the previous 40 sessions
Volume at least 1.5 times its 50-day average
